title: The Sky Loft - Skyline Views / 3 Miles to Downtown
description:
A luxury two story home with incredible views of Music City. Three miles from Broadway, this is the perfect place for friends or couples to retreat and relax while exploring all that Nashville has to offer. The kitchen and living room are spacious and perfect for gathering, with a balcony off the back to enjoy the best views of downtown. The downstairs bedrooms and master bath are tranquil and comfortable, with a private deck complete with rocking chairs.

The space
• The views are unbeatable from this apartment! Private balcony on second floor and private deck on first floor. 

• Designed to provide quiet, luxurious, and relaxing spaces, so you look forward to coming home after exploring the city.

• Fully appointed dry bar on second floor — a must for evening entertaining.

• Spacious living room, kitchen and dining area upstairs. Bedrooms and master bath downstairs.

• Apple TV provided in the living room so you can watch movies and shows.

Guest access
You will have access to the entire space.
